info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v2-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Payoff Retrieval API provides users with access to detailed information regarding the payoff amounts of mortgage loans. This endpoint allows consumers, such as loan officers and financial analysts, to efficiently retrieve and analyze mortgage payoff data. The service is designed to facilitate decision-making processes in mortgage finance by offering clear insights into loan statuses. Typical use cases include generating payoff statements, evaluating loan performance, and managing client communications regarding outstanding balances.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the payoff amount for a specific loan, providing essential details required for settlement or refinancing purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the payoff information for loans. It should include the necessary parameters as specified in the schema to ensure that the right data is fetched.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the loan payoff details.
